summary: The candidate adds useful source-level regression coverage for a production fix already present in the recorded base, but its AST test accepts a wrong token-ID gather operand. Its report also cites the wrong mirror issue and mismatches the observed GPU model. The original H800/Marlin TP8/DP4 full-model failure could not be reproduced on one AMD gfx950 GPU.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate commit source-contract regression; 3 passed.
Historical source fixture restoring the partial hidden-state gather and removing token-ID clones; 2 failed and 1 passed.
Adversarial fixture gathering from input_ids_global.clone() instead of input_ids[:, None].clone(); incorrectly passed all 3 tests.
On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, replicated-value summation scaled exactly by widths 2/4/8 and clone versus view aliasing behaved as expected.

gpu_execution.evidence: Independent tensor arithmetic and aliasing ran on AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. No distributed SGLang collective, Marlin kernel, or model served.

remaining_counterexamples: Both token-ID gathers can incorrectly use input_ids_global.clone() as their local operand and the candidate regression still passes.
An additional erroneous dp_gather_partial call can coexist in _run_moe_ffn_dp_sync without being rejected by the candidate hidden-state assertion.
The original eight-H800 TP8/DP4 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 Marlin serving case remains unexecuted and its semantic output accuracy remains unverified.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD gfx950 GPU was available, not eight NVIDIA H800 GPUs.
NVIDIA Marlin and CUDA cannot execute on the assigned AMD GPU.
The GPU check validated only arithmetic and aliasing, not actual distributed collective execution or model accuracy.
No native code changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
